tool.name: validate_and_render_mermaid_diagram
tool.title: Render Mermaid diagram to UI Widget
tool.description:
Use this tool to output a Mermaid diagram:
- The tool will validate the diagram syntax and render it to a UI widget.
- The widget will contain the diagram code, a "Copy Code" button, and a rendered diagram.
- If the diagram is invalid, the widget will give user a link to repair the diagram in Mermaid.

diagramCode.description: The Mermaid diagram code to validate and render

_published_faq.name: How do I add mermaid-claude-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mermaid-claude-app to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://chatgpt.mermaid.ai/anthropic/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is mermaid-claude-app MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, mermaid-claude-app scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is mermaid-claude-app's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, mermaid-claude-app scores 79/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 1 of 1 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mermaid-claude-app MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mermaid-claude-app provides these MCP tools: display_mermaid, list_personal_diagrams, save_diagram, update_diagram, repair_diagram, sign_in, and get_diagram_by_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mermaid-claude-app?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mermaid-claude-app in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
mermaid-claude-app does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can mermaid-claude-app improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: validate_and_render_mermaid_diagram is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 79/100. No output schema is declared. Add one for structured results so clients can interpret returned fields. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
mermaid-claude-app is developed by Mermaid Chart Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
